error_signature: Gradual memory growth leading to OOM restarts
scenario_description: notification-worker ka memory usage pichle 6 ghante mein steadily barh raha hai, restart cycle shuru ho gaye hain.

ground_truth.likely_cause: memory leak introduced by a recent code change that retains references to processed notification objects
ground_truth.correct_action: rollback recent deployment; if not recent, schedule investigation and use scheduled restarts as temporary mitigation
